learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the structure of scientific research and work.
Students learn the structure of mathematical thinking.
Students learn the place of statistics within mathematical sciences.
Students learn a brief history of science.
Students learn a brief history of mathematics and statistics.

syllabus_topics: Scientific method. Basic concepts and approaches.
Classification of scientific disciplines. Origin and development of mathematics.
Mathematical thinking method. Mathematics and logic. Induction. Deduction.
Distinction between theoretical and applied sciences.
Some problems of philosophy of science.
The role of mathematics in science.
The role of statistics among mathematical sciences.
Introduction to the history of science. Science in ancient times. Science in the Middle Ages and the Islamic World. Quiz
Science in new and modern ages. / Contemporary discussions on the structure of scientific work.
